career_ladder.note: The Kerala Administrative Service (KAS) was constituted under the Kerala Administrative Service Rules, 2018 as the premier middle-management administrative cadre of Kerala. Recruits enter as KAS Officer (Junior Time Scale) Trainees and advance through Senior Time Scale, Selection Grade, and Super Time Scale before promotion into the Indian Administrative Service (IAS) Kerala Cadre under the IAS (Appointment by Promotion) Regulations, 1955.

exam_scheme.note: Examination is conducted in three successive stages in accordance with the Kerala Administrative Service Rules, 2018: Preliminary Examination (Objective OMR screening test comprising Paper I and Paper II carrying 100 marks each, 200 marks total), Main Examination (3 conventional descriptive papers carrying 100 marks each, 300 marks total), and Interview / Personality Test (50 marks). Final merit list is prepared out of 350 marks (Main Examination + Interview).

financial_package.note: KAS Officer (Junior Time Scale) Trainees are appointed under the Kerala State 11th Pay Revision (G.O.(P) No. 27/2021/Fin dated 10/02/2021) in the pay scale of ₹77,200 - ₹1,40,500 with entry basic pay of ₹77,200.
financial_package.pay_source_label: Kerala PSC Gazette Notification (Category Nos. 001/2025, 002/2025, 003/2025) & Finance Department, Government of Kerala
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Kerala State 11th Pay Revision entry basic pay of ₹77,200 at standard 58% DA (effective 1 Jul 2025, ₹44,776) plus House Rent Allowance (Class A Corporation 10% or ₹7,720, Class B Municipalities 6-8%, Class C 4% or minimum slabs) and executive allowances; net in-hand reflects statutory deductions including National Pension System (NPS, 10% on Basic+DA = ₹12,198), MEDISEP health insurance (₹500/month), State Life Insurance (SLI), and Professional Tax.
official_perks: Government earmarked official residential accommodation or designated quarters in district headquarters
Official staff car / vehicle with driver for official duties and field inspections
Comprehensive medical coverage under the Kerala Government MEDISEP cashless insurance scheme
Mobile phone, broadband, and office administrative expense reimbursement
Earned leave encashment and Leave Travel Concession (LTC) benefits as per Kerala Service Rules (KSR)
Deputation opportunities to central ministries, statutory boards, and international development agencies
